blocks.text: Data, data science ki bunyad hai. Data raw facts (kache haqaiq) aur values (qeematon) ka majmua hai jin se information (maloomat) banti hai. Data numbers, text, images (tasaveer), audio ya video ki shakal mein ho sakta hai. Har roz mukhtalif kaamon se data paida hota hai. Analysis se pehle data ko samajhna zaroori hai, kyunke har qism ke data ko alag tareeqe se sambhala jata hai. Data ko theek samajhne se sahi results milte hain, aur ghalat samajhne se ghaltiyan hoti hain. Sahi results ke liye data accurate (durust) aur reliable (qabil-e-bharosa) hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Data ki quality (miyar) aakhri results par bohat asar dalti hai. Kharab data ghalat nateejon tak le ja sakta hai.
Types of Data: Structured and Unstructured (data ki qismein)

Structured data ek saaf, muqarrar shakal mein hota hai, jaise tables ya spreadsheets. Is mein rows (qataarein) aur columns hote hain jo samajhna asaan hai. Misal: talaba ki mark sheets aur databases. Unstructured data ki koi muqarrar shakal nahi hoti (Figure 6.2). Misal: emails, images, audio aur videos. Unstructured data ka seedha analysis mushkil hai; ise process karne ke liye khaas tools chahiye. Dono qismein aham hain, aur aaj ke systems dono istemal karte hain.

blocks.text: Data Sources and Data Collection Methods (data kahan se aur kaise jama hota hai)

Data bohat se sources (zaraye) se jama kiya ja sakta hai. Aam sources: surveys, interviews, forms, sensors aur online platforms (jaise blogs, social websites waghaira). Manual (haath se) data collection mein insani mehnat lagti hai, jab ke automatic (khud-kaar) data collection mein machines aur software kaam karte hain. Data real time (usi waqt, foran) bhi jama ho sakta hai aur waqt ke saath store karke bhi. Kaun sa tareeqa ho, yeh analysis ke maqsad par munhasir hai. Achhe sources aur durust collection se analysis ki quality behtar hoti hai.
Data Storage and Management Concepts (data ko mehfooz rakhna aur sambhalna)

Data storage ka matlab hai data ko baad ke istemal ke liye save karna. Data files, databases ya cloud systems (internet par servers) mein rakha ja sakta hai. Theek storage data ko zaya hone se bachati hai. Data management ka matlab hai data ko tarteeb se rakhna aur us ki dekh-bhaal karna, taake data aasani se mil jaye aur istemal ho sake. Security (hifazat) data management ka aham hissa hai. Backup systems (data ki doosri copy) data zaya hone se bachate hain. Achhi tarah sambhala hua data kaam ki raftar aur efficiency (kam mehnat mein zyada kaam) barhata hai, aur lambe arse tak kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Data ka analysis karne se pehle yeh achhi tarah samajhna bohat zaroori hai ke data kis qism ka hai.

blocks.prompt: Har ek ko structured ya unstructured batayein: class ka hazri register, record kiya hua lecture, fees ki spreadsheet, WhatsApp voice messages.
blocks.explanation: Structured: hazri register aur fees spreadsheet (muqarrar rows aur columns). Unstructured: record kiya hua lecture (video ya audio) aur voice messages (audio).

items: Data: raw facts (numbers, text, images, audio, video); is ki quality results par asar dalti hai.
Structured: rows aur columns; unstructured: koi muqarrar shakal nahi.
Sources: surveys, interviews, forms, sensors, online; manual ya automatic collection.
Storage: files, databases, cloud; management mein security aur backup.
